ranking.reason: Missing color check: a same-color predecessor (C[j-1]==C1[j]) can overwrite V1[j] and silently discard the old best different-color value from C2.
Second-best update uses elif, so a valid different-color predecessor equal to old best may not restore the lost C2 candidate.
When colors match, relies on V2[j] being correct; if C2 tracking was wrong upstream, answer wrongly becomes invalid here.
j=0 second-best state V2[0] is never maintained, so index-0 predecessors offered at j=1 are incomplete.
Blindly adds vi to V1[j]; if V1[j] sentinel handling or stale color mismatches exist, invalid states can propagate.
